resources.string: Tap chips to build your bet, then press Place bet.
Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over. Face cards count 10; an Ace counts 1 or 11.
Hit takes a card. Stand stops. Double doubles your bet for one last card.
Split a pair into two hands. Surrender gives up a bad hand for half your bet back.
A blackjack pays extra. Out of chips? Rebuy and keep playing. These are play chips, never real money.
The name comes from a bonus once paid in some American casinos for an Ace of spades with a black Jack.
Tap Flip. Every player turns over their top card.
The highest card wins and takes all the cards in play. Aces are high.
A tie means war: tied players put cards face down, then flip one more. Higher takes the whole pile.
In Choose 3 you see your top three cards and pick one in secret. Win by holding every card.
A game of classic War can last hundreds of flips, which is why this one has a round limit.
